title: Residential Programs Graduate Assistant
bio: Nickoll will work with the incredible Residential Life team to plan and implement meaningful opportunities that support the newest members of our community to experience student life. A current graduate student at HGSE, Nickoll is excited to meet and work with low-income, first-generation, and students of color at Harvard to be successful in higher education and beyond. Nickoll graduated from The University of Texas at Austin with a Bachelor of Science in Education, where she worked in residence life, orientation, and advising as an undergraduate student. In her spare time, Nickoll enjoys trying out coffee shops around the city and watching movies with her AMC A-List membership. Area Residential Life Role Graduate Assistants
